name: DNS / certificate / web-infrastructure configuration
product_relevance_reason: A DNS record or a certificate observation is a configuration fact. The reading that would make it strongly product-relevant — that a name pointing at a provider indicates a customer of that provider — is the semantic promotion §22 forbids. Stripped of it, the proposition is about zone contents.
exact_world_state_unit: the answer a resolver receives for a defined query at a moment

routes.note: Performs its own active DNS measurement daily, over zone-based, top-list based and CT-log-based populations.
source_says: 308 million domains measured on a daily basis

routes.apparatus: Rapid7 Project Sonar forward and reverse DNS studies
routes.note: Publishes dated forward and reverse DNS study files from its own resolution.

same_proposition_reason: Two genuinely independent active resolvers exist, which is rare. Their populations differ — zone-derived and top-list-derived against Sonar's own known-name set — so the same alignment question as Q1 applies.

certificate_sub_route_refused.$comment: §18. Certificate issuance and active TLS response are not the same fact.
certificate_sub_route_refused.statement: Certificate Transparency logs are a transcription of what was submitted to them, and several independent log operators carry the SAME submitted certificate. Mission 1.58 named that READING_A_PUBLISHED_VALUE_IS_NOT_MEASURING_IT, and it applies unchanged here. CT presence is not an active observation and cannot pair with one.

commercial_purpose_note: OpenINTEL's access conditions and licence were not stated on the pages read.
unresolved_load_bearing_gaps: whether the two resolvers' populations can be aligned over a frozen name list
whether resolver vantage differences are documented on either side
blocked_from_selection_by: WEAK product relevance. §33 requires moderate or better for strategic viability, and §22 forbids strengthening the relevance by promoting a configuration fact into a customer relationship.
mission: 1.69 — Independent Product-Relevant Quantity Class Selection V1
